description: The bar chart illustrates the performance ratio (in percentage) of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct categories: an unlabeled first category (likely representing a baseline or general knowledge domain), “Songs,” and “Basketball.” The vertical y-axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, ranges from 60% to 90% with tick marks at 10% intervals. In the first category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve ratios near 90%, while ChatGPT scores approximately 80%. For “Songs,” Llama3 and Qwen2 again perform similarly at around 90%, with ChatGPT slightly lower at approximately 77%. In the “Basketball” category, Llama3 scores around 85%, Qwen2 drops to approximately 78%, and ChatGPT rises to about 84%. The chart visually suggests that Llama3 consistently performs well across domains, Qwen2 excels in general and song-related knowledge but lags in basketball, and ChatGPT shows variable performance, underperforming in general and song domains but improving notably in basketball. The bars are grouped by category along the horizontal axis, with each group containing three adjacent bars corresponding to the models, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. The chart is tilted slightly, giving it a 3D perspective, but the data remains clearly readable.
